description: This file contains implementation code for verifying and checking pack files in a version control system, including functions for CRC checks, signature verification, and consistency checks against pack indexes.

methods.name: int verify_pack(struct repository * r,struct packed_git * p,verify_fn fn,struct progress * progress,uint32_t base_count)
